LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 1.1.2 TIME RELATED GREETINGS AND FAREWELL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 1.1.2 Time related greetings and farewell
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 1.1.2 Time related greetings and farewell, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: When do people greet? 2. How do people bid farewell?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 1.1.2 Time related greetings and farewell together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: cooperation as learner role-plays time related greetings and bidding each other farewell.

● Respect: etiquette as learner role-plays greeting one another relating to different times of the day.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
7

Social cohesion as the learner practices time related greetings and farewell while interacting with other people.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learners relate performing various activities at different time of the day with Time in mathematical activities.

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, Pictures showing different activities for
